race_name: Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir)

top_categories.workout_context: 57 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
89ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir), surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir)'s mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 57 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir)'s demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir). Train it until it feels boring.
5,151ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
5,151ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir). Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir), that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Low-cadence force work for 5,151ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.

race_overlay.heat: September in Sigacik, Seferihisar, Izmir Province, Turkey can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir). Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir)’s 57 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gran Fondo Izmir (formerly Turkcell Granfondo Izmir) requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Over Under to prepare you for 57 miles of mixed terrain in Sigacik, Seferihisar, Izmir Province, Turkey.
